items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewer mentions George Delcy as the owner of a venue ('George Delcy's place') where the interviewee played, but the interviewee does not confirm a personal relationship or direct interaction with George Delcy.

ctx.x: Then you just told me, why, why, in 1918 you, why I had my teeth fish. Uh-huh. What'd you say? I said you played with me when I used to have my teeth fish.
You mean? No. Yeah, but I didn't play with him. He was playing without teeth down at, uh, down at the, uh, George Delcy there.
Yeah, yeah, you used to play with me when I got my teeth fish. I didn't call a right man George Delcy.
